items.q: Will resizing reduce my photo's quality?
items.a: Images are resized from your original, so use a large, sharp photo. Shrinking keeps quality well, while enlarging a small photo does not.

items.q: Which image sizes does it create?
items.a: Sizes for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube and X, including posts, stories and covers.

items.q: Is the social media image resizer free?
items.a: Yes. The social media image resizer is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up or login.

items.q: Can your team design our social creatives?
items.a: Yes. Our social media team creates posts, carousels and reels in the right sizes for each platform.
